scope: offline expert-action imitation-oracle candidate-search headroom only; no World Model, goal/value model, simulator outcome, reranker, or controller evaluation
sample_contract: for each explicitly admitted task/demo group only: natural observation features and proprio at k predict frozen expert actions[k+1:k+9], for every legal 0<=k<=T-9

historical_reference.allowed_use: comparison only; its demos45-49 numerical arrays are not opened by this audit

primary_metric.name: raw expert-action MSE
primary_metric.oracle: minimum MSE candidate with stable lowest-index tie break
primary_metric.interpretation: imitation-oriented candidate-search headroom only; unavailable at deployment and not task success or a future planning objective

candidate_families.seed_rule: direction0 uses seed_base+ordered_partition_row and exactly reproduces C1-v2.1; later directions add direction_index*1000003
candidate_families.P1: nested same-scale N=8,16,32,64 after P0 N=3
candidate_families.P2: N32 translation-only, rotation-only, gripper-only, translation+rotation, and full-non-gripper; translation+rotation and full-non-gripper are exact aliases for this 7-D interface
candidate_families.P3: same-scale N32 at 0.5x,1x,2x and mixed N32 cycling 0.5x,1x,2x across the 31 alternatives

P4.update: unweighted current-iteration elite mean and population std
P4.objective: expert-action MSE oracle; diagnostic and unavailable at deployment

candidate_families.P5: N32: A0 + 8 full@1x + 8 full@2x + 8 translation-only@2x + 7 rotation-only@2x

statistics.unit: task-stratified demo/init block; resample four complete demos per task and retain every legal action window

decision_rules.case_A: no expanded one-shot clears the meaningful gate plus 2pp-over-P0 gate and iteration4 does not clear the iterative gate -> BLOCK_PLANNER_PROTOTYPE
decision_rules.case_B: at least one expanded one-shot clears the meaningful gate and exceeds P0 by >=2pp with paired CI lower >0, while iterative does not significantly exceed one-shot -> GO_EXPANDED_CANDIDATE_PLANNER_DESIGN
decision_rules.case_C: iteration4 clears the meaningful gate and exceeds the best one-shot relative gain by >=5pp with paired CI lower >0 -> GO_MODEL_BASED_PLANNER_DESIGN

forbidden: read reward, done, success, or final task outcome
train or modify a World Model, encoder, actor, proposal policy, reranker, score, goal, value, cost, or controller
claim expert-action MSE is a deployment objective or task-success metric
authorize spatial World Model or controller work
add candidate family after evaluation access
